data.exact_reserve_text: The favourable movement in net claims incurred of GBP 12,695 (2014: GBP 8,042,000) primarily derives from benign claims development across most classes of Syndicate 1861's business including Primary Excess of Loss and Single Job Construction.
specific_events: Terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center, 11 September 2001

prior_year_events.event_name: Terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center
prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate 340 legacy exposure relating to the 11 September 2001 attacks remains material; reserving for this loss is based on probability-weighted market loss scenarios and assumptions on outwards reinsurance recoverability.

named_events.event_name: Terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center
named_events.loss_description: Material exposure in respect of the terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center on 11 September 2001; reserving uses probability-weighted market loss scenarios and assumptions on recoverability of outwards reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2255 opened gross claims outstanding at GBP 254.547m. During 2015 there was a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 17.123m (a release), driven by benign claims development across much of Syndicate 1861's portfolio (notably Primary Excess of Loss and Single Job Construction) and related movements in reinsurance recoveries and bad debt provisioning. Legacy exposure remains from the 11 September 2001 World Trade Center attacks (Syndicate 340 business) which continues to be reserved on scenario/probability-weighted assumptions.
raw_causal_phrases: benign claims development across most classes of Syndicate 1861's business including Primary Excess of Loss and Single Job Construction
a corresponding reduction in reinsurance claims recoveries which resulted in a significant reduction in the provision carried for bad and doubtful debts

A material exception to this approach relates to the Syndicate 340 business closed into Syndicate 2255 and in particular its remaining exposure in respect of the terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center on 11 September 2001
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure calculated from the gross claims development table (2011 underwriting year) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior years' note was present. Triangle contains only a single underwriting year (2011) and Syndicate 340 legacy exposures (9/11) are specifically called out as material which may distort comparisons. LOB-level PYD amounts are not quantified in the report and are therefore reported as null. Gross premiums written are negative overall due to the reinsurance acceptances line being negative; amounts are taken from the segmental analysis (page 24).
